notes: Deferred Return Guard. Return hotfixes now install only after the Operations core functions are ready. For Installer / Customer returns, an exact Product Master or Inventory Record identity takes priority over stale legacy Unit=Foot fields, so general stock returns cannot be misrouted into the carpet child-roll workflow. Existing legacy return records are repaired in the editor at runtime without changing inventory until completion. Version display is persistently guarded at V6.10.1.
